paragraphs: R' Shmuel ben Halafta and R' Yirmeyah, in R' Adda bar Ahavah's name: Jerusalem Berakhot, end of chapter 3. That matter, at the beginning of Benei ha-Ir, reads R' Shmuel bar Halaf.
